entry.title: Stable Channel Update for Desktop
entry.content:
The Stable channel has been updated to 141.0.7390.130 for Windows, Mac and 141.0.7390.122 for Linux, which will roll out over the coming days/weeks.

This update includes 2 security fixes. Below, we highlight fixes that were contributed by external researchers.

[$11000][361234567] High CVE-2025-11111: Type Confusion in V8. Reported by External Researcher on 2025-10-01

[$5000][362345678] Medium CVE-2025-22222: Inappropriate implementation in Skia. Reported by External Researcher on 2025-10-02

Google is aware that an exploit for CVE-2025-11111 exists in the wild.

entry.title: Stable Channel Update for Android
entry.content:

High CVE-2025-33333: Heap buffer overflow in ANGLE.
